Lemma
[Completeness of closed Lipschitz hypersurfaces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0500 ↗ def:chow-iii-i39-lipschitz-hypersurface 1. appi:1.40\group Distance spheres

If $\N $ is connected, closed, and Lipschitz in a complete Riemannian manifold, then its intrinsic length metric is complete.
Proof

\sketch Constant-speed minimizing sequences of paths are uniformly Lipschitz. Arzela– Ascoli gives a limiting path in the closed set, and lower semicontinuity of length shows that it realizes the intrinsic distance.

□
